'''Kantaros Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within the [[Fervse'dra]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Both system]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a military outpost and medical facility. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the station was taken over by the new regime and put into use as [[Prison/Legends|jail]] for various high-level prisoners. The station continued to house a civilian population, and control of the facility was nominally in the hands of the civilian stationmaster [[Cleben]]. The station was occasionally visited by [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] affiliated with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization, who provided illicit wares for the facility's inhabitants.

In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] captured the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Thi Xon Yimmon]]&mdash;the leader of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]-based resistance group the [[Whiplash]]&mdash;and held him aboard Kantaros Station. Vader's initial attempts to extract information from Yimmon were unsuccessful and he placed the Cerean under watch, to monitor him so that a new approach to forcing the resistance leader to reveal details of the Whiplash's activities could be formulated. In addition, a large contingent of [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]], including the noted Inquisitor [[Probus Tesla]], accompanied Vader to Kantaros Station and took up residence aboard the facility. Soon afterward, Yimmon's allies [[Jax Pavan]], [[Den Dhur]], [[I-5YQ]] and [[Sacha Swiftbird]] staged a rescue attempt and freed Yimmon from the clutches of his Imperial captors. Pavan briefly engaged in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was eventually able to escape, blowing up one of the station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays as he fled.
